title: COMILOG unions’ renewed strike and simultaneous assemblies at Moanda and Libreville
location: General assemblies reported at Moanda and Libreville; detailed public venue not established
scope: Six COMILOG unions; assembly attendance and broader coordination unknown
organizer: Collectif des organisations syndicales de la Compagnie minière de l’Ogooué (COMILOG)
threshold_50_evidence: Neither source gives an assembly count; employee workforce or union membership cannot be substituted for attendees.

occurrence.evidence: Both sources report a renewed indefinite COMILOG strike following union assemblies; GabonActu describes simultaneous meetings at Moanda and Libreville.

date.evidence: GabonReview says assembly on 2 December; GabonActu describes the strike beginning the night Tuesday-to-Wednesday in an article dated 4 December. Conflicting day-level timing; month precision retained.

location.evidence: Moanda is identified by GabonReview; GabonActu identifies simultaneous union assemblies in Moanda and Libreville.

state_target.evidence: The primary demand is directed to COMILOG administration. Sources also mention application of Labor Code arbitration and mediation by the labor minister, but do not establish that participants directly demanded state-policy change.

threshold_50.evidence: No attendance number, and the sources do not establish whether the assemblies were public.

notes: Keep candidate separate from the August strike suspended on 27 September; current sources describe a renewed December strike. Do not infer size or a state target from minister mediation alone.
open_questions: Were the simultaneous union assemblies public gatherings and where exactly were they held?
How many people attended each assembly simultaneously?
Did participants direct a specific demand to the Gabonese state or only to the private company?
Which day did the renewed strike begin?

title: Transport-sector intersyndical assembly reviewing agreement during ongoing strike
location: Assembly location not reported; GabonActu article is from Libreville but does not establish meeting site
scope: Intersyndical ministry transport workforce; attendance unknown
organizer: Intersyndicale du ministère en charge des transports
threshold_50_evidence: The report lists 747 SOGATRA employees, which is workforce size and not assembly turnout; no participants counted.

occurrence.evidence: A general assembly reviewed progress under a protocol and voted to ease the ongoing strike.

date.evidence: Article and meeting are dated 20 December 2024.

location.evidence: Meeting venue not given; article does not establish a public location.

state_target.evidence: The agreement was with the transport ministry/tutelle; source reports wage arrears and Treasury funds, but this is a follow-up/settlement meeting, not a newly stated demand.

threshold_50.evidence: No assembly count; 747 refers to SOGATRA employees, not people present.

notes: This is a December assembly during an ongoing strike whose onset source reports as 15 June. It is not coded as a new December strike; whether the assembly itself meets public-gathering criteria is unresolved. The Treasury payment is recorded as state response/accommodation, not attendee evidence.
open_questions: Where was the general assembly held and was it open/public?
Was a fresh demand to the state made on 20 December or was this meeting solely to assess implementation and end the June strike?
